label: D2 a2->S2 common; larger after unrewarded trials, a1 switches, and S1-leaning belief
terms: (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * np.clip(belief_lo, -3, 3) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * np.clip(belief_lo, -3, 3) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * (last_is("a1 S1 u") + last_is("a1 S2 r")) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * ep_dec ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * belief_cover
explanation: Fires only at D2 when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 (common); zero at D1/GO and other D2 outcomes. Magnitude within a2->S2: strongly raised (~+0.5) when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward 0), and by about the same amount after a1 S1 u / a1 S2 r (the trials a model-based agent switches away from a1 after, i.e. a fresh switch to a2); a1 S1 r before lowers it. Also raised when the trial before last was unrewarded, and graded by the ideal-observer belief: larger the more S1 is believed good (belief_lo > 0), especially after an unrewarded trial, so it is big when reaching S2 is not what the belief favours / evidence for S2 is weak; it declines slowly over the episode (ep_dec). The hidden good state, this trial reward and the next choice add nothing. All terms observed-only (belief, trial history; no value/policy). Test R^2 beyond timing 0.588 (dev 0.576) vs all-cue ceiling 0.57 and all-observed reference 0.40; the earlier policy-based description (weak a2 preference) is matched or exceeded by belief + reward history, so little is lost without model outputs. Residual misses: some large activations on window-first trials and after rewarded a2 S2 trials.

terms: (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * (last_is("a1 S1 u") + last_is("a1 S2 r"))
(phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * (last_is("a1 S1 u") + last_is("a1 S2 r"))

issues: The model-based reading is not supported over a simpler one. The term (last_is('a1 S1 u') + last_is('a1 S2 r')) scores test R^2 0.588; swapping it for plain (prev_action == 1), i.e. any switch away from a1, scores 0.587. The data cannot tell 'a model-based agent's switch trials' apart from 'the previous choice was a1'. With prev_action==1 in the fit, a1 S1 r (-0.38) and a1 S2 u (-0.31) are about equally lower, so the label should say 'switch from a1', not single out the model-based pattern.

Without the belief and reward controls, the activation within a2->S2 is highest after a1 S2 u (+1.30, against +0.97 for a1 S1 u and +0.58 for a1 S2 r). The model-based ordering only appears once the fit conditions on prev_reward and belief, so it comes from confounding, not from the raw pattern.
'The next choice adds nothing' is slightly wrong. Adding (tv('action',1)==1) gets weight +0.31 and raises test R^2 from 0.584 to 0.599. This is a future variable and the gain is small.

Belief claim checks out. Within a2->S2 the clipped belief_lo slope is +0.20 after unrewarded trials and +0.04 after rewarded ones, and roughly monotone. Without the belief terms, test R^2 drops from about 0.58 to 0.54. The U-shaped (peak in the middle) belief decile profile in the overall residual comes from mixing other D2 outcomes, not from this cell.

No large systematic misses remain. D2 mean error is -0.04 and the worst (phase, previous trial) cells are about -0.07. Terms for the window's first trial, the late episode (ep_trial >= 90), early trials, a2 streaks, the hidden good state and this trial's reward each change test R^2 by 0.005 or less.
The reported scores reproduce: test R^2 beyond timing 0.588, against the 'all' ceiling of 0.57 and the all-observed reference of 0.40.
